title: Spring—The Child
credit: Alfred Stieglitz Collection, National Gallery of Art
rights_basis: The NGA scholarly catalogue records publication in Camera Notes 5:3 (January 1902), opposite page 165, and The Work of Alfred Stieglitz (New York, 1904). The photograph was therefore published in the United States before 1931 and its US copyright term has expired. This uses the publicly served 800-pixel catalogue image, not a restricted high-resolution download.
identity_age_limit: The cited Spring catalogue does not identify the child or state an exact age. Do not assign a name or a numeric age from this record. It is an additional period clothing/proportion comparison, not a likeness of John Glessner.
use: Supplemental review reference found after construction and the original first-role review packet. No model, recipe, source card or runtime figure changed; no owner approval or photographic match asserted.
observations: Small child outdoors in a light knee-length outer garment, bonnet, stockings and dark high shoes. The prototype uses a different two-tone frock without this bonnet, so this is a comparison for review rather than a claimed match.
